summary_en: 300,000 shares (1.18% of shares outstanding) up to ¥500M. Execution window Jun 16 – Sep 30, 2026. Method not specified; likely open-market or ToSTNeT-3. Stated rationale: improve shareholder returns and enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 15 June 2026, SoftCreate Holdings' board of directors resolved to acquire up to 300,000 treasury shares (1.18% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at a total cost not to exceed ¥500M. The acquisition period runs from 16 June 2026 to 30 September 2026. The company stated the purpose is to improve shareholder returns and enable flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. The specific acquisition method (open-market, ToSTNeT-3, or self-tender) is not stated in the disclosure.
